decisions.headline: 公寓政治模拟游戏《RULES OF RESIDENCE》公布，计划2027年登陆PC
decisions.reason: 证据达到本期收录标准。
decisions.summary: Toydium公布公寓管理政治模拟游戏《RULES OF RESIDENCE》：玩家扮演背负35年房贷的新手母亲，进入由独断理事长控制的管理委员会，通过制定规则、团结住户或争夺控制权改变社区；游戏计划2027年推出，并将参加东京电玩展2026。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Onimusha: Way of the Sword tops one million launch-day sales

entries.headline: Apartment politics simulation RULES OF RESIDENCE announced for PC in 2027
entries.summary: Toydium announced RULES OF RESIDENCE, an apartment-management political simulation in which a new mother with a 35-year mortgage joins a board controlled by an authoritarian chairperson and can rewrite community rules. The PC game is planned for 2027 and will appear at Tokyo Game Show 2026.
entries.timeNote: Both outlets date the announcement to September 7; the packet provides no precise publication time.
entries.verification: The opened reports from 4Gamer and Famitsu independently support the developer, premise, 2027 release plan, and Tokyo Game Show 2026 appearance.

entries.headline: Thief Simulator 3: First Loot announced with four-player co-op
entries.summary: PlayWay announced Thief Simulator 3: First Loot, a free prologue containing the first mission and map from Thief Simulator 3. It supports up to four-player co-op, is planned for Steam, and lists Japanese interface and subtitle support.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 00:15 UTC on September 8, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays the publisher announcement and Steam listing. This item is limited to the confirmed prologue format, player count, platform, and language support.

entries.headline: puzzlez - a shapez game announced for PC in 2027
entries.summary: tobspr Games announced puzzlez - a shapez game, a standalone factory-building puzzle title planned for Steam in 2027. Expanded from an idea originally intended as shapez 2 DLC, it will feature more than 75 multi-level production-line puzzles.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 13:00 UTC on September 7, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the developer, 2027 PC plan, puzzle count, and transition from DLC concept to standalone game.

entries.headline: Stellar Code console versions announced for fall 2026
entries.summary: KEMCO announced console versions of the science-fiction mystery visual novel Stellar Code for PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, and Switch 2 in fall 2026. They will include the PC setting materials and a digital edition of the bonus novel distributed at Comic Market 107.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 07:18 UTC on September 7, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports KEMCO's announcement, all four platforms, the fall 2026 window, and the added materials.

entries.headline: Fast-paced 3D platformer Lightspeed Lina announced with Kickstarter campaign
entries.summary: Independent developer CornflowerBlue announced Lightspeed Lina, a fast-paced 3D action-adventure platformer planned for Steam, alongside a Kickstarter campaign seeking US$45,000.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published the report at 14:22 UTC on September 7, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report supports the developer, genre, Steam platform, and US$45,000 crowdfunding target.

entries.headline: Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition launches for Switch on September 10
entries.summary: Tigertron announced Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition for Nintendo Switch on September 10. The enhanced release adds a default third-person view, visual and quality-of-life improvements, and a new ending song, Blue Life, by Ken Ishii.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published the report at 09:45 UTC on September 7, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report supports Tigertron's announcement, the September 10 Switch release, and the listed enhancements.

entries.headline: Onimusha: Way of the Sword tops one million sales on launch day
entries.summary: Capcom said Onimusha: Way of the Sword sold more than one million copies on its first day, while cumulative Onimusha series sales passed 10 million. The game launched September 4 for PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, and PC.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published the report at 07:10 UTC on September 7, within the fixed window; the sales figure refers to the September 4 launch day.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays Capcom's announcement and supports both sales milestones, the release date, and platforms.

entries.headline: Street Fighter 6 DLC fighter Arjun launches October 13
entries.summary: Capcom announced that Arjun, the second fighter in Street Fighter 6's Year 4 DLC roster, will launch October 13 and unlock for owners or purchasers of the Year 4 Character Pass or Ultimate Pass.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published the report at 23:54 UTC on September 7, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report supports Capcom's announcement, the October 13 date, Arjun's roster position, and the eligible passes.

entries.headline: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance shows new Charge Blade actions
entries.summary: Capcom released a Charge Blade video for Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance showing its Boost Bracer state, new combo routes, and multiple clash actions. The major expansion is planned for 2027.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 06:43 UTC on September 7, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report describes Capcom's new official video and supports the Boost Bracer, combo, and clash details. Community reactions are not presented as official facts.

entries.headline: Forza Horizon 6 PS5 version remains planned for 2026
entries.summary: Playground Games confirmed that the PS5 version of Forza Horizon 6 is still planned for release in 2026 and can now be wishlisted on the PlayStation Store. A specific launch date remains unannounced.
entries.timeNote: IGN published the report at 19:28 UTC on September 7, within the fixed window.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report directly quotes Playground Games on the 2026 PS5 plan and wishlist availability; it does not provide a firm date.
